work_title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny

places.name: Glasgow City Centre (as New York City)
places.connection: The streets of Glasgow, particularly around St. Vincent Street, were dressed with period-accurate props and storefronts to double as Manhattan for the 1969 Apollo 11 ticker-tape parade sequence.

places.name: Ear of Dionysius (Orecchio di Dionisio)
places.connection: This limestone cave is the location where Indiana Jones discovers the tomb of Archimedes, a key plot point in the search for the second half of the Dial.

places.name: Fes el-Bali (Medina of Fes)
places.connection: The ancient, labyrinthine streets of the Fes medina were used as the setting for the Tangier marketplace and the thrilling tuk-tuk chase sequence.

places.name: Bamburgh Castle
places.connection: This imposing coastal castle served as the Nazi-occupied fortress in the film's opening flashback sequence, set in 1944.

places.name: Glasgow city centre
places.connection: Filmed here to double as New York City for the 1969 ticker-tape parade sequence celebrating the Apollo 11 astronauts.

places.name: Ear of Dionysius (Orecchio di Dionisio)
places.connection: The limestone cave where Indiana Jones and Helena find the tomb of Archimedes.

places.name: Castellammare del Golfo
places.connection: Used for the deep-sea diving sequence and various boat scenes as the characters search for the Grafikos.

places.name: Bamburgh Castle
places.connection: Featured prominently in the 1944 prologue, serving as a Nazi-occupied castle where a de-aged Indy battles his enemies.
